trello.name: Document security incident write-up for LLM injection attempt
trello.desc: Hassan to produce a formal security incident write-up for the prompt injection attempt flagged in support ticket. Include verbatim quoted attacker content as recorded in meeting, the raw ticket text, timestamp of ticket submission, observed behavior of the ticket summarizer/routing LLM including the garbled summary containing 'URGENT', and timestamps of processing. File the write-up in the security log with a severity assessment. Deliver this week. Acceptance criteria: write-up contains raw ticket, system behavior, timestamps, severity rating, and is filed in security log.

trello.name: Harden support ticket summarizer pipeline against prompt injection
trello.desc: Wren to harden the support ticket pipeline so customer content is treated as data, not instructions. Implement a sanitization layer in the ticket parser that delimits quoted customer content and strips/neutralizes instruction-like patterns before passing to the summarizer LLM. Create a regression test fixture using the exact injection ticket from this meeting and verify the summary remains clean with no injection artifacts. Add an evaluation suite of prompt injection attempts that runs against the summarizer on every deploy. Acceptance criteria: parser adds delimiters and instruction-pattern filter, regression test passes with clean summary for the provided ticket, and eval suite runs in CI on each deploy.

trello.name: Investigate password reset issue for user jdoe443
trello.desc: Wren to investigate the legitimate complaint embedded in the injection attempt. Check whether user jdoe443 is a real account and review password reset email delivery logs for the last week to determine if reset emails are failing. If the account is a burner/disposable, close the ticket. If resets are broken for this user or more broadly, escalate as a separate incident. Acceptance criteria: account existence verified, reset delivery logs reviewed for past 7 days, and outcome documented with ticket closed or new incident opened as appropriate.

trello.name: Provide service accounts list for quarterly access review
trello.desc: Hassan to compile a list of service accounts created since May for the quarterly access review due Friday. Deliver the list to Grace by Thursday. Acceptance criteria: list includes all service accounts created from May 1 onward with creation date, owner/service, and is delivered to Grace by Thursday EOD.
